title: Work in a chat window is lost; one place for the flow (2026-10-25)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
So am agent should establish work in the correct epics and location. Are you suggesting to just add to the same epic?

Although at this immediate moment what matters most is the establishment of a single place to define and manage this flow.


Rules around how to define storieshow to attach to it create epics.
How to check appropriate problems 
How to route to a working group
How to test position in a flow

The problem here is that when we are running work in a chat, the window gets lost and work is abandoned half way. An agent needs to always be able to define a sequence of tasks in a way that allows them to be found in other chats. This is why we have the programme. 

We need to be able to drive work from the cli, but need to flag epics/sequences that are in progress so that we can find them again. 

Agents should not simply bypass the flow, so there needs to be a standard interaction that makes sure we have worked out what the problem is and then how we are attempting to fix it.
